selection_rule: require all eight evaluations and reject observed Stage-one matched-other/null violations; maximize actual both-order successes; maximize median self-minus-matched-other effect; minimize mean matched-other KL; break exact ties by literal grid order; choose exactly one provisional triple before the method-wide unrelated audit; never fall back
